docs_events.rationale: Owner edits CHANGELOG.md and ADR/spec body text during the doc overhaul; this PR edits only governs frontmatter and generated references, and reports the stale mentions

owner_directive: First ADR-056 PR: remove the legacy previewer forms completely (ADR-054 §8, option A) ahead of 0.3.6. imaging/spectroscopy/LCMS packages may break. Shared pieces of scistudio.previewers used by panels move under scistudio.panels and the previewers package is deleted. FR-005 project default (previewers.json) is dropped; ties use user choice only. PanelManifest legacy fields (module_url, export_name, css, version, asset_root) are removed. Owner authorizes editing ADR/spec frontmatter governs lists only, to drop entries for deleted files; no body text.
